lesson: The system is consistently attempting to front-run reversals against the dominant 4h/Daily trend, resulting in 10 consecutive losses as it misidentifies distribution phases as structural breakouts. The reliance on low-timeframe liquidity sweeps is failing because these setups are occurring within broader distribution zones rather than at high-timeframe demand levels.
adjustment: Implement a strict 'Trend Alignment Filter' that prohibits taking long positions unless the 4h timeframe confirms a clear BOS to the upside, effectively ignoring all counter-trend liquidity sweeps.
methodology_flag: Trust SMC liquidity sweeps less when the 4h/Daily structure is in a confirmed distribution phase.
